This template is used to include a header line for pages of the [[Spanish by Choice]] wikibook. It is used like this:

<pre>{{SbcHeader | id=<name of the page> | title=<title>}}</pre>

There is a specialized version for the SpanishPod lessons ([[Template:SbcHeaderSpanishPod]]).
